name: Python documentation
capabilities: Official Sphinx metadata export, locally queried by exact case-sensitive symbol name; stable native kind/name plus minor version and captured inventory hash.
Native entries include modules/classes/functions and other domain roles; ten Python module/class/function cases tested.
No full-text, topic, author or procedural-task search is established by this research route. The deployed app has a separate, historically recorded implementation; its state is unchanged.

query.cost: Public metadata export; no paid service or key used.
query.paging: One 168,139-byte compressed 3.15 inventory, 20,490 entries / 1,394,647 decoded bytes observed; no server cursor. Exact local query scans a bounded snapshot; no pagination or whole-document text import.
query.identity: Python + inventory minor version + domain/role + name; inventory SHA-256 distinguishes mutable builds. Reader patch label 3.15.2 observed separately.

import_limits.redirects: record and stop; no automatic follow
import_limits.duplicate_or_changed_project_version: reject import; no fresh verified examples

licensing: Official current Python license explicitly covers software and documentation under PSF License v2, including royalty-free worldwide reproduction/display/distribution subject to license/copyright retention and derivative-change notice. Code examples from 3.8.6 are also 0BSD. Metadata export is officially distributed for references; retained unmodified inventories and normalized selections carry analysis/legal-notices/python-psf-v2.json. Incorporated third-party components require their own notices. This is a documented permission analysis, not a grant to use PSF trademarks for endorsement.
limitations: Declared subset: exact names in English Python 3.15 inventory. No multilingual or broad-topic recall claimed.
The /3.15/ URL is minor-version scoped and currently reports 3.15.2; it can change on rebuild. Inventory hash and observation date are necessary; versioned URL alone is not immutable.

Two anonymous WebKit reader sessions passed on desktop/mobile at a managed cloud vantage. Physical egress country was not independently established; no India/USA network-availability certification or full WCAG conformance claimed.

Two current inventory requests cover different minor versions; earlier same-day 3.15 observation is retained. Cross-day reliability, accountable refresh ownership and refresh/deletion rehearsal remain open.

No numeric request quota or SLA found in captured policy; no unlimited-use inference. Research serializes per host, waits at least three seconds and stops on denied policy, redirect or access/rate/error response.
next_action: Resolve the two explicitly partial reader/operating sections; keep exact-symbol scope, PSF notice and inventory snapshot identity. Continue unresolved catalog identities independently.

identity_and_duplicates.summary: PSF is the documented operator/IP steward. One Python origin spans releases/languages. The representative py:class:pathlib.Path identity resolves separately in 3.14 and 3.15. Preserve kind/name + minor and snapshot hash; creator is project-level, not a fabricated per-symbol author.

coverage_and_languages.summary: C12 technical documentation / I18 software work: English Python 3.15 exact-symbol subset, 20,490 current inventory entries. Ten sampled module/class/function lookups do not establish all-entry recall or broad industry documentation coverage. USA/India network coverage stays unknown; global license territory is not access proof. Non-English, topic and procedural queries unsupported.

query_contract.summary: GET https://docs.python.org/3.15/objects.inv without credentials returns a bounded Sphinx v2 zlib inventory; official intersphinx documentation describes name-to-relative-URI mapping. Exact local query {mode: exact_symbol, text: pathlib.Path} returns py:class:pathlib.Path and its canonical anchor. No server query parameters/cursor; reject invalid project/version, duplicate identity, external/version-escaping URL, decompression overflow, redirects and import failure. Raw export, hashes, requests, ten outputs and negative cases are retained.

rights_and_cost.summary: Official current Python license explicitly covers software and documentation under PSF License v2, including royalty-free worldwide reproduction/display/distribution subject to license/copyright retention and derivative-change notice. Code examples from 3.8.6 are also 0BSD. Metadata export is officially distributed for references; retained unmodified inventories and normalized selections carry analysis/legal-notices/python-psf-v2.json. Incorporated third-party components require their own notices. This is a documented permission analysis, not a grant to use PSF trademarks for endorsement. Anonymous exports/readers used no paid service/account. Numeric quotas were not published in the captured pages; serial courtesy pacing is not provider authorization for unlimited traffic.

reader_access.summary: Anonymous full reference sections for pathlib.Path and json.loads rendered at exact inventory anchors in separate WebKit sessions (1280×900 and 390×844). Both had one main landmark/H1, working keyboard focus, no password prompt, no page errors or horizontal overflow. Screenshots visually reviewed; mobile signature wraps and reference text is readable. Two browser-launch environment failures are retained; no TLS validation was disabled.
open_questions: Confirm source availability from independently established USA and India network vantage points before country-specific availability claims.
Complete broader keyboard/screen-reader accessibility sampling before production acceptance; current evidence is limited to landmarks, focus and overflow.

quality_and_relevance.summary: Ten distinct current exact symbols passed in two same-day observation sessions, without increasing the ten-case count. Five predeclared topic intents were explicitly rejected as unsupported. Negative/gibberish/empty/Unicode/case/whitespace/call-parentheses tests preserve strict equality: an empty exact lookup is not absence of relevant instructions. Comparison against 19,782-entry 3.14 inventory finds 765 new and 57 absent native keys in 3.15; these are snapshot differences, not confirmed deletions. Small exact-match sample does not measure catalog recall.

operating_limits.summary: Current import: 168,139 compressed bytes, 1,394,647 decoded bytes, 20,490 entries; local measured parse 0.804 s with tracemalloc overhead and 18,278,677-byte tracked peak. One export then local queries, no hosted datastore. Research request timeout 20 s, compressed and decoded caps 4 MiB, policy-aware pacing >=3 s, no retries/redirect following. Proposed refresh: candidate snapshot, compare project/minor/hash/native-key differences, quarantine missing/changed entries, preserve old provenance and mark stale rather than publish failed/empty refresh.
open_questions: Assign an accountable maintainer/review cadence before declaring maintainable integration coverage.
Rehearse candidate refresh, removed-entry handling and stale-snapshot labeling; parser rejection tests alone are not a completed refresh workflow.
Obtain a later-day observation for reliability; same-day repeats are not cross-day evidence.

decision_and_followup.summary: Retain as a candidate with ten verified exact-symbol examples and six complete analysis sections; full qualification remains false because reader geographic/accessibility and maintenance gates are open. Research approval is separate from historically deployed source status. Useful next triggers: a later-day scheduled pass, an approved country vantage, and a maintenance-owner decision. Continue independent source work while those remain open; no runtime change.

analysis_refs.heading: Implemented and checked locally
analysis_refs.text:
- Redis coordinator, shared record/page caches, stored federation sessions,
  application-wide source counters and their setup/CI prerequisites are removed.
- One live source request per search/detail. Native cursors are signed, bounded,
  context-bound and usable after process restart. Replay makes another request.
- Deterministic tests cover source routing, no fan-out, token tampering/expiry,
  old-session rejection, page cycles/depth, underfilled pages, access classes,
  invalid provider responses, provider errors, cancellation and exact resolution.
- OpenAlex verifies free allowance/known pricing/zero prepaid funds before each
  request. Existing tests reject paid balances, changed prices and exhaustion.
- 570 server tests pass with zero skips; 179 client tests and typecheck pass.
  The disposable PostgreSQL used for existing account regression tests is local
  test infrastructure, not a free-content runtime dependency or hosted resource.
- 62 focused desktop/mobile browser checks pass, including live coverage,
  paging, source switching/website links, reading, save/reload/reopen and three
  reading lights. Full build, isolated client-only build, SEO/deployment checks,
  12 Python importer tests and refresh-script tests pass.

analysis_refs.text:
`python tools/content/refresh_catalogs.py --output-dir /tmp/new-free-candidates`

analysis_refs.heading: Contracts and limits
analysis_refs.text:
- One provider per server request; the browser coordinates the search. No Redis,
  SQL, hosted cache, persisted session or new account/service.
- Fixed-origin adapters bound response size, deadline and paging. Signed cursors
  bind provider, query, types, language, page size and expiry; they work across
  function restarts without storing query results. Changed indexes can change
  pages; exact-key deduplication never merges similar titles or distinct editions.
- The new transport serializes requests per host within an instance, spaces them
  two seconds apart and honors 429 Retry-After. It has no automatic retries.
  This courtesy is not a global request quota across Vercel instances.
- Python's official compressed symbol inventory is bounded and cached for one
  hour in process memory. Search is over symbol/section names, not arbitrary
  full documentation text. Version and same-origin URL checks fail closed.
- GDL uses its public content-search route and published WordPress REST book-ID
  route for exact details. Word-level metadata checks reject substring noise
  such as `Rain` matching only `Shakrain`. Its provider offset advances even when
  inspected rows fail relevance, so filtering does not trap pagination.
- Thoth searches active monographs/edited books in explicit publisher IDs. Exact
  resolution verifies publisher membership and active status. Only canonical
  digital links on reviewed publisher hosts become reading/download actions;
  print, retail and unreviewed mirrors do not.
- LoC requires `access_restricted=false`, digitization and an online resource for
  free access. BHL searches only its biodiversity collection and excludes known
  access-restricted items. Their content rights still vary by item.
- LibriVox is title search and distinct recording identity. Its documented JSON
  404 for no audiobooks is an empty result; other errors remain failures. US
  public-domain statements do not claim worldwide rights.
- Snapshot sources remain labelled incomplete/stale when appropriate. Unknown
  access is hidden by default; an explicit checkbox reveals labelled results with a source record link; no old
  observation is refreshed merely because a user searches it.
- Existing OpenAlex free-allowance and zero-paid-balance checks remain unchanged.
  No key is returned to the browser. No full books/audio are copied.

analysis_refs.heading: Verification and release record
analysis_refs.text:
Current live results, including source IDs and reading links, are in
[evidence/knowledge-release-2026-11-05](evidence/knowledge-release-2026-11-05/).
The initial Python inventory parser failed on names containing spaces; it was
corrected against the actual Sphinx format. An initial LoC request timed out;
subsequent search, detail and paging passed. These are retained as failures, not
relabelled successes. Test failures caused by local socket permission were rerun
with loopback networking enabled; no application security setting was weakened.

identity.deduplication: One official Python documentation origin across translations and releases; Sphinx is the metadata protocol/tool, not another content origin.

representative_item.creator: Python documentation contributors; no per-symbol author metadata in inventory
